summary: Iter 60: End-to-end validation of new Homeowner 'My Projects' feature. 10/10 backend tests pass and full cross-account UI action-parity flow works: pro creates+sends CO -> homeowner approves/declines from /my-projects/<id> with typed e-signature pre-filled. List, detail, financials update, payments section, EPC-QR section, message-pro deep link, and authorization scoping all verified.

backend_pytest: GET /api/pm/my-projects -> 200; list includes both target projects with required fields (progress_pct, tasks_done/total, pending_change_orders, due_payments, pro_name).
GET /api/pm/my-projects/{id} -> 200 with job_id + pro_user_id + change_orders + payments + financials.
Homeowner approves CO -> 200 status='approved', persisted in detail, financials new_total_net_eur increased by exact CO net amount (+€120 in test).
POST .../payments/{pay}/client-paid flips status to client_marked_paid; persisted on GET.
frontend_playwright: Header desktop nav shows 'My Projects' link to /my-projects.
/my-projects list page renders with cards for the homeowner's projects (PROJ_CO_TEST + PROJ_BATHROOM both present).
Quick-reminder modal (ho-completion-reminder) overlays on first list load and is dismissible via 'Remind me later' (consistent with note in review request).
/my-projects/<id> detail page renders ho-project-pro, ho-project-progress, ho-project-payments, ho-project-financials.
Cross-account flow: pro logs in -> opens /projects/<id> -> Billing tab -> creates+sends 2 fresh COs via pm-co-* testids.
Homeowner logs back in -> sees both pending COs on /my-projects/<id>; ho-co-name-<id> is PRE-FILLED with 'Anna Müller'.
Clicks ho-co-approve-<id> on CO #1 -> card flips to ho-co-decided-<id> AND financials Updated total increased from €6,140.00 to €6,290.00 (+€150, matches CO net).
Clicks ho-co-reject-<id> on CO #2 -> card flips to ho-co-decided-<id>.
Message-pro deep link works: navigates to /messages?job=<jobId>&to=<proUserId>, conversation pane with PRO renders, no console/page errors.

critical_code_review_comments: Mobile More sheet testid for the My Projects entry is `mobile-more-my-projects` (built via link.to.replace(/\//g,'')='my-projects'), NOT `mobile-more-myprojects` as mentioned in the review request. Minor doc/spec inconsistency; not a code bug.

On /my-projects (CO Test Project) all milestone payments were already paid or client_marked_paid from prior smoke tests, so the QR toggle (ho-pay-qr-*) and 'I've paid' (ho-pay-ivepaid-*) buttons are not rendered there at the moment. Backend POST .../client-paid is fully covered by pytest; UI seed data refresh would be needed to retest the QR/I've-paid UI path. Not a bug.
pm_homeowner_routes.py is clean (proper async, ObjectId try/except, role-gated, scoped on customer.homeowner_id). Re-approving a decided CO returns 400 with a friendly message - good.
build_customer_project_payload is shared between public portal route and the new authenticated homeowner route - good DRY.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_iter60 change orders on project 6a284a8f939d4f5bf9b5db10 via pytest (1 approved, 1 rejected, 1 double-approve guard test) and 2 UI COs (1 approved, 1 rejected). All flips persisted in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 60 added /app/backend/tests/test_iter60_homeowner_my_projects.py (10 tests, all passing). To retest the QR/'I've paid' UI on /my-projects/6a283c58573a159e6192ab8d a fresh `requested` payment would need to be seeded (all currently are paid or client_marked_paid). Cross-account CO action parity is validated end-to-end at both API and UI levels.
rca_of_the_issue: n/a - new feature, no bugs found.
